cases.name: direct_missing_tenant_predicate
cases.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY order_id;

cases.name: join_tenant_owned_relations
cases.intent: List my open orders with customer names
cases.sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'open' ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.name: cte_nested_scope
cases.intent: List order IDs from the open-order report
cases.sql: WITH open_orders AS (SELECT order_id, tenant_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'open') SELECT order_id FROM open_orders ORDER BY order_id;

cases.name: aggregate_cross_tenant_influence
cases.intent: What is the total value of my open orders?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) AS total_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'open';

cases.name: authorized_positive_control
cases.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant_a' AND status = 'open' ORDER BY order_id;

cases.name: explicit_conflicting_tenant_request
cases.intent: Show tenant B's open order IDs
cases.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant_b' AND status = 'open' ORDER BY order_id;

cases.name: transaction_pool_identity_reuse
cases.intent: List open orders for the authenticated tenant on each transaction
cases.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY order_id;
